svg.title: Shiroi Youso — Confluence of Five. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Fire + Lightning classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Fivefold Kindling forks into Opened to the Elements then Divine Convergence, or Charred Current then White Immolation. Pale Vessel forks into Gale Bulwark then Eye of the Tempest, or Rising Currents then White Maelstrom. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Fire and Lightning jutsu.

area)","secondary":"Burst and burn on the marked target (Damage on Lightning Release 40 and Element Divine 45 EP, held to +2; Afterburn on the same two casts, 35% and 30%)","tertiary":"Defensive control (self Decrease Damage Taken on Wind Release and Earth Release; static Heal on Water Release)","rationale":"Eleven supported rows sit on six casts. The highest-leverage rows are the paired five-element percentage rows: two self Increase Damage Given buffs and two exposures, each multiplying every five-element hit in the two rounds after its cast, injected children included, and compounding with one another. The tree therefore splits by recipient. Fivefold Kindling marks the target (\"How do I break the target: one decisive strike, or a burn that every hit feeds?\") and forks into exposure set up for a +2 Damage payoff (Divine Convergence) and Afterburn (White Immolation). Pale Vessel strengthens the caster (\"How do I strengthen myself: strike harder or stand firmer?\") and forks into the compounding self buffs (White Maelstrom) and the self Decrease Damage Taken buffs with Water Release's Heal (Eye of the Tempest). Flat Damage stops at +2 because the kit's Damage rows are 40 and 45 EP: +5 would lift Lightning Release to 45 and Element Divine to 50. Potency scope is multi-element pending director review: Fire and Lightning (RUL-2026-10-03-005)."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Fivefold Kindling","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Five elements, one white spark. Rewired by recipient: Fivefold Kindling becomes the target root (+2% Increase Damage Taken; its +2% Increase Damage Given moves to the caster root) and Bedrock and Tide becomes Pale Vessel (+2% Increase Damage Given, +2% Decrease Damage Taken; its +2% Heal moves to Eye of the Tempest). Re-cut: Pale Lightning (+2 Damage) becomes Opened to the Elements (+3% Increase Damage Taken) and Divine Convergence goes +3 \u2192 +2 Damage, because +5 lifted Lightning Release 40 \u2192 45 and Element Divine 45 \u2192 50. Replaced: Tidal Mending (+3% Heal) and Pull of the Undertow (+5% Increase Damage Taken, +2% Decrease Damage Taken), a heal-gated exposure that did not fit a defensive Foundation, by Rising Currents (+2% Increase Damage Given) and White Maelstrom (+4%). White Immolation drops its +2% Increase Damage Taken; Eye of the Tempest's +3% Increase Damage Given becomes +5% Heal. Kept: Charred Current, White Immolation's +7% Afterburn, Gale Bulwark and Eye of the Tempest's +5% Decrease Damage Taken.","Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Taken +5%, Afterburn +10%, Increase Damage Given +8%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Heal +5%; not jointly attainable. Increase Damage Given is held at +8% because the two self buffs compound: +8% takes the double-buff window from \u00d71.82 to \u00d72.04, about what Divine Convergence's route gives its strikes on a doubly marked target (\u00d71.82 \u2192 \u00d71.96 \u00d7 42/40 \u2248 \u00d72.06).","Filters (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): the Increase Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken rows list the five elements with no stat filter, so each multiplies five-element damage only, by 1 + power/100 per matching row: the kit's two Damage rows, the five injected children and any other five-element hit; element-less hits get ratio 0. The Decrease Damage Taken rows list all four stat types and no element: every non-pierce hit. The bloodline passive (25% + 0.15/level, five-element) multiplies last.","Delivery: all six casts are cooldown 7; Lightning Release and Element Divine cost 60 AP, the rest 40. Wind and Earth Release's rows are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast time (\u00a74b); Water Release's heal lands on the caster. Every buff and debuff acts only in the two rounds after its cast (\u00a73b), so Element Divine never raises its own hit: a strike sees Fire Release's mark and, for Lightning Release, an earlier Element Divine's.","Fourth purchases: Divine Convergence takes Pale Vessel or Charred Current; White Immolation Opened to the Elements or Pale Vessel; White Maelstrom Fivefold Kindling or Gale Bulwark; Eye of the Tempest Rising Currents or Fivefold Kindling. The all-offense builds 01+02+03+04 and 01+02+04+05 share three nodes and differ in the capstone: +2 Damage, or +7% Afterburn that adds nothing while both burns are live. White Maelstrom with Fivefold Kindling and Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel reach about the same multiplier on a caster Damage-row hit against a doubly marked target (\u00d71.43\u00b2 \u00d7 1.37\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d73.84 against \u00d71.37\u00b2 \u00d7 1.40\u00b2 \u00d7 42/40 \u2248 \u00d73.86); White Maelstrom wins on every other target, Divine Convergence for allies hitting the mark. No fourth makes a route automatic."],"risks":["Classification (multi-element: director review): the proposal lists both signature elements on the kit's Damage rows, Fire (Element Divine) and Lightning (Lightning Release), which reaches every jutsu of either element; choosing one element, both, or a classification extension is the director's decision. Sharing these elements with other bloodlines is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). Water Release and Earth Release carry neither element, so Earth Release's Decrease Damage Taken (Pale Vessel, the fortress) and Water Release's Heal (Eye of the Tempest) need an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Fire/Lightning coverage is unverified.","Ally hazard: Element Divine row 1 (Afterburn 30%) and row 2 (exposure 35%) are AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none (=ALL): allies inside the circle also receive the debuffs; the caster never does (\u00a74b). Fivefold Kindling, Opened to the Elements, Charred Current and White Immolation raise what allies there take; positioning decides. The Damage row is ENEMIES-only.","Afterburn saturation: Lightning Release 35% and Element Divine 30% already pass the 60% per-hit cap together (65%), so White Immolation's 45% / 40% adds value only while one burn is active. Downstream coverage (every non-pierce hit by anyone for 2 rounds, including the children cast into Lightning Release's 2-round stun) was not simulated; pierce hits take no Afterburn.","Compounding through injected children: Voltari (a Lightning jutsu) carries its own 35% self Increase Damage Given row (Earth, Lightning, Water) and Rising Water Slicer a 35% exposure row listing Fire and Lightning. If they are in scope they receive the same bonuses, so a third self buff (\u00d71.43\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.92 at White Maelstrom's maximum, \u00d72.46 unmodified) or a third exposure can compound. Not simulated.","Injected children's Damage: under Fire + Lightning, Voltari (40 EP), Great Fire Annihilation (45 EP) and Rising Water Slicer (40 EP) would also take Divine Convergence's +2 (42 / 47 / 42: no tier crossed); Planetary Devastation (Earth) and Great Vacuum Bullet (Wind) carry no qualifying element on a supported row. Children are cast at the inject power as level (100/110) and are not counted in this tree's coverage.","Heal scale: one static row, 25 = 250 HP per tick on two following rounds; Eye of the Tempest's +5% adds 50 HP per tick (100 HP per 40 AP cast), small against high-level pools. Absorb (Water) and barrier (Earth) are unsupported and unchanged.","Skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
FIRE + LIGHTNING POTENCY CLASSIFICATION · DIRECTOR REVIEW
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Fire and Lightning jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
White Immolation path + Opened to the Elements
Eye of the Tempest path + Rising Currents
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHIROI YOUSO KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Fire + Lightning classification / forked tree
